desc: Co-op: player 2's partner hops up a step and back down. Rogueport's plaza, Mario put at -60 0 -40 (by the left door's stone step, y 8); player 2 takes Goombella and hops left along the door's step (up onto it at y 8), along it, then down off it toward the camera. Each hop lands and she stands or walks again (not left in the jump pose, not floating). Shots: on_step (she stands on the step), off_step (back down on the street)
log_must: player 2's character: hop landed at \(\S+, 0\.0, \S+\) after \d+ frames, pose PKR_
